_comment: Plain-language explanation per permission, shown in the dashboard and the report. Owner: F writes the words, B owns the file. English, because the report and the demo are in English.
@broad_host: Can read and change everything on every website you open.
@specific_host: Can read and change pages on these specific sites.
@content_script_broad: Runs its own code inside every page you load.
@csp_unsafe_eval: Its security policy allows turning text into running code (unsafe-eval).
debugger: Can control open pages at developer-tools level, including reading and changing anything on them.
webAuthenticationProxy: Can act as a proxy for web sign-in (WebAuthn) requests.
nativeMessaging: Can talk to programs installed on the computer, outside the browser.
cookies: Can read and change cookies, including the login sessions they hold.
proxy: Can route all browser traffic through a server of its choice.
vpnProvider: Can act as a VPN and carry network traffic.
webRequest: Can observe the web requests the browser makes.
management: Can list, disable or remove your other extensions.
desktopCapture: Can capture what is on your screen.
certificateProvider: Can provide client certificates used for authentication.
enterprise.platformKeys: Can use the device's enterprise keys and certificates.
userScripts: Can run user scripts inside web pages.
clipboardRead: Can read what you copy, which often includes passwords.
tabCapture: Can record the content of a tab.
declarativeNetRequestWithHostAccess: Can block or redirect requests on sites it has access to.
webRequestBlocking: Can block or modify web requests before they are sent.
history: Can read your full browsing history.
pageCapture: Can save complete copies of pages you visit.
contentSettings: Can change per-site settings such as camera, microphone and JavaScript.
browsingData: Can delete browsing data such as history and cookies.
downloads.open: Can open files that were downloaded.
scripting: Can inject scripts into pages it has access to.
tabs: Can see the address and title of every open tab.
downloads: Can start, read and manage downloads.
identity.email: Can read the email address of the signed-in browser profile.
bookmarks: Can read and change your bookmarks.
webNavigation: Can follow which pages you navigate to.
identity: Can request OAuth tokens for your accounts.
topSites: Can read your most visited sites.
declarativeNetRequest: Can block or redirect requests using declared rules.
activeTab: Can access the current tab only after you click the extension.
idle: Can tell when you are away from the computer.
unlimitedStorage: Can store an unlimited amount of its own data.
contextMenus: Can add items to the right-click menu.
sidePanel: Can show its own panel at the side of the browser.
fontSettings: Can read and change font settings.
power: Can keep the computer from sleeping.
webview: Can show other web pages inside its own windows.
